newsitem.title: CHINA: China breadbasket province sees bigger harvest.
newsitem.headline: China breadbasket province sees bigger harvest.

text.p: Grain output in China's breadbasket province of Sichuan is expected to increase by 1.1 million tonnes this year to 46.92 million tonnes, the Xinhua news agency said on Monday.
The southwestern province had adopted several measures to give incentives to boost output, including new methods of contracting land to farmers and setting new state grain purchasing prices, it said.
Total agricultural output value of the province this year was expected to reach 181.9 billion yuan ($22 billion), up 4.2 percent compared with 1995, it said.
Sichuan, China's biggest pork producer, expected some 79.83 million pigs to mature by the end of the year, up by 2.6 percent over last year, it said.
